gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk has curves that sweep open rather than curling shut, and it keeps a quiet, modern look. Over a long stretch it reads smoothly, while Bellota Text up top draws its c, e and s open with no shading to steer the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-hubot-sans: Bellota Text draws a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, and its heading feels commanding and distinctive. Hubot Sans lies beneath it, modern and wide in the e.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ara: Easily readable open apertures give IBM Plex Sans Arabic a clean, approachable voice in running text. Above it, Bellota Text brings a tube-like stroke like neon glass, so the plain sans below feels even more grounded.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-dev: Bellota Text has a drawn-with-a-technical-pen steadiness, commanding and distinctive, and it earns its keep big and short. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari follows with rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-heb: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew reads approachably, its s and c left with open, uncrowded mouths. And Bellota Text above it has stroke contrast of exactly none, a distinctive heading that sets off the low-key sans-serif below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads in a professional, approachable way, each curve ending in a clean, open gap. And Bellota Text above it feels like following a single thread, which a longer passage below would carry on smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Bellota Text brings a marker-drawn plainness to every character, commanding and distinctive at the top. And IBM Plex Sans KR sits beside it, modern and open at every curve end, so the two feel friendly together.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: IBM Plex Sans Thai reads in a modern, contemporary way, its c ending in two points that open apart like pincers. Bellota Text stays above with hairlines that never appear, and a longer passage in the plain sans would flow along easily.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-imprima: Smooth and tube-like, every line looks poured, and the terminals flare outward in Imprima below. Bellota Text is best at commanding headings; Imprima handles the approachable body.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-inclusive-sans: Commanding and distinctive, Bellota Text opens its c, e and s with no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Inclusive Sans handles the quieter work, with round letters whose rims match the stems and an open-ended look on every curve, a professional sans-serif.
